item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 24/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a fresh to strong easterly airstream, it will be windy with showers over the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. A southerly airstream is expected to bring humid and foggy weather to the region during the weekend. A cold front will reach the coast of southern China early next week, and will bring unsettled weather to the region again.

Date/Month: 24/03 (Thursday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, becoming east force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Cloudy to overcast with rain.
Temp range: 16 - 20 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High

Date/Month: 25/03 (Friday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first. Becoming south force 4.
Weather: Cloudy with showers. Isolated thunderstorms at first. Showers will ease off gradually during the day. Coastal fog at night.
Temp range: 20 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
